owner: Dr Elise Vincelette and Dr Raman Samra
summary: A midtown Toronto orthodontic practice with dual board certified doctors and five locations is a strength, but dead menu links and a blank results gallery appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The menu items About Us, Services, Patient Education and Locations appear to link to #, and the sticky bar Call and Treatments links appear to point to anchors that do not exist.
findings.cost: Patients cannot find locations or treatments, and the call button may not work.
findings.fix: Working menu pages and a working call button.

findings.problem: The Real Patients, Real Results gallery appears to show ten After and Before labels with no images, and the Learn More About Us heading appears with no content.
findings.cost: An empty results section removes your strongest proof.

findings.problem: The page lists five locations but the body appears to describe one office at 3016 Yonge Street, and the free assessment appears to be described three different ways.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell where to go or what the offer is.
findings.fix: One clear locations section and one offer.

findings.problem: Booking appears to be a request form only, article excerpts appear cut off mid sentence, and no testimonials appear.
findings.cost: Patients wait for a callback, and cut text and missing reviews weaken trust.
findings.fix: On site booking, finished excerpts and visible reviews.

redesign: One locations section and offer, plus booking and reviews.
